system.description:
The Asuri Sect wields the emotions and passions that are so often spurned by exoteric, conventional contemplation cults.

License: Demon Body ✦

Needs: ❂

After barking out a taunt, the Cultivator may EXUDE KILLING INTENT to draw the ire of all those within [5 + Killing Intent] meters of her. All within her aura gets a temporary Attachment of Intimidation toward her as long as they're within the aura's range. All attempts to KILL THE BUDDHA against her suffer -2, as if affectd by the Attachment. If she damages anyone within her Killing Intent, they must succeed on a Demand [DEMON BODY] HRT + STILLNESS Check or lose 1 Morale. This only affects entities that are of equal or lower Sidhi Stages.

Asuri fight with an indomitable and intimidating fury. Unrelenting, their very faces and miens change. They fight by brutalizing with hands and with giant weapons. Cleaving through and splitting God’s head from His body.

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator imbues her weapon or her empty hands: that weapon's damage rises by 1.

The Asuri Sect have a lifelong rivalry with the Adamantines who prize the training of a diamond-hard consciousness and a thunderbolt quick-strong mind.

License: Demon Body ✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator may focus her meditation to strengthen her strikes. While installed, whenever she KILLS THE BUDDHA with a weapon that is [GREAT] or [COLOSSAL], she immediately begins with a single Solid Opening. Additionally, she no longer suffers penalties from those Mods.

To strengthen one’s body beyond its limits is to eat the face of god. Spit it out, don’t swallow. See? You’ve eaten yourself. The Vajra Warriors abused this technick to the point that their normal muscles were so limp that they could not move without activating this meditation beforehand.

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator installs RED BLACK DEMON THEWS to empower their muscles to the highest limit. While installed, she gains +1 Physique and all attacks she does inflicts KNOCKBACK up to [2 + DEMON BODY] meters after damaging. If she uses this upon an immovable object or terrain, she launches herself instead.

Asuri wield their Sidhi to strengthen their musculature. Their Microcosmic Orbits become complexes of pistons and intramat hydraulics to strengthen their bodies. The Asuri are highly sought after, but many gang bosses know Asuri Licenses themselves.

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ✹

Solid Opening: On a Controlled Torso, the Cultivator can hurl the entire body of that target. She hurls them up to [3 x DEMON BODY] meters in any direction, even up (to Juggle) or down (to Knockdown and inflict Falling damage). If the target collides with a thick wall, he is embedded into it from intramaterial the force of the Hurl.

"Asuri are exceptionally hard headed. It helps. Those that are too soft or bend too easily crumble to the conditoining needed to master DEMON BODY."

License: Demon Body ✦✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Asuri reduces all damage to her Head by 1. All her damage with her head rises by 1, and she can stun opponents with it if she manages to slam her own head against the target's head.

The Asuri revel being in the midst of the fight. They are taught to drink the blood of their enemies.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

Upon inflicting damage with a weapon, activate KURUKULLA BLOOD DRINKING to heal one Part by [DEMON BODY].

A rare technick used by the Asuri Akinna Kejor when she had to fight through a hellworld seeping into Hingsajagra. She synthesized this into a Technick after getting out and making sure that she slew 100 demons with it.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Asuri swings her weapon and sends an explosion of devilcutting in a 5m long, 10m wide cone blast. All that fail to avoid the swing suffer [CRUSHING] weapon damage.

More than just anger, the Asuri Sect wields explosive libido—that is, Desire, not just in the sexual sense—as a poison from which the antidote can be cured.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦

Needs: —

The Asuri can speak the language of chaos and demonkind. She is no longer susceptible to any fear-based or intimidation-based influences and can feasibly use her VIO to speak with other entities. IF SHE HAS EXUDE KILLING INTENT: Her Killing Intent aura can now affect entities 2 Stages above her. All hostiles within her Killing Intent aura also now suffer -1 to KILL THE BUDDHA CHECKS.

The Asuri Sect take their name after the mythological Antigods that went against the Devas. Their strikes thunder and strike fear even to the Highest of Thrones, thus it was integral to MORTAR to sublate the Asuri into the neoliberal capitalist fold.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

When the Cultivator's attempt to damage a non-Head Part is COUNTERED, she can activate THUNDERING ANTIGOD TEMPER to inflict damage on the Part anyway.

Who’s to say that demonkind are not subject to the targeted propaganda of bourgeois media and ideology? The Asuri Sect steal away the Sidhi that has been stolen from them since the beginning.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

When the Cultivator KILLS THE BUDDHA against more than 1 hostile target, she can activate ASURI'S WRATH to go on a berserker fury outrage powered by Fury Sidhi: she gains +1 Quick Opening per hostile past the first.

"Set your heart ablaze!" — Elder Asuri Masao

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

For every Flame installed, convert any HP from any Part into a +1 to all strength based Checks and all KILL THE BUDDHAs with melee weapons. When it is uninstalled, the HP returns, but the Cultivator suffers Fatigue penalty (and as with Fatigue rolls, -1 per hour afterward).

Even the vaunted heavenly armors of the gods stand no chance against the might of the Antigods. This Technick—passed down by the first Asuri—renders all protective soak moot against sheer brute violence.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

When the Cultivator deals damage and any amount is Soaked, she can activate VAJRA-SUNDERING VAJRA to immediately destroy all Soak for that Part, and then deal damage anyway + the number of Soak destroyed.

The greatest of the Asuri was said to be Dattreya Wairini herself, who was a student of Jenma Malari. Applying Dialectic Luciferianism, Dattreya synthesized passion and serenity, lust and asceticism, self and other, into the elevated form of Passion, which overcame the unnecessary duality, and revealed to her the True Nature of Reality and the innermost Divine Workings of Matter.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

When the Cultivator enters Samadhi, she may activate this to enter her Chthonian Seraph Body, to a limit of [PHYSIQUE] hours. While in this body, her skin turns the color of her Sidhi and she gains an extra set of arms that can hold other weapons or make other attacks: she gains +2 to all KILL THE BUDDAs. While in this Body, she can burn ✹ when in a KILL THE BUDDHA to COUNTER a Quick or Solid Opening.

Devil Tigers are ancient, elder things. Tiger only in the way of mien, but not in gross physical form. These Devil Tigers conquered the world. They took on the forms of impervious Adamantine Humans. They are primordial beasts. They are the first Buddhas, burdened to slay the seraphim that came before, like mosquitos to a god corpse.

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹

This attack can only target a single entity. It is a horrible single slash: with a Perfect Opening, she can activate SPITEFUL DISEMBOWELMENT OF SERAPHIM to immediately inflict triple damage on the target's Head and Torso as her blade cleaves through.

items.name: Mountain of Corpses, Seas of Blood

system.description:
"The giants of old shaped entire Spheres..." — The Codex of the Ancients

License: Demon Body ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹

The Cultivator exhales, and burning Sidhi cloud-refuse billows. Then, she disappears into the violence: she deals double her weapon damage to all entities within 30m.

Ensure no word leaves the victim's lips.

License: Devil Beast ✦

Needs: ✹; DAGGER; SABER

Perfect Opening from behind or by surprise: +1 damage. The target can’t speak, scream, or cast Magick for 1 minute, even if they survive.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦, Technick, DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…and every sword strike is met with a dancing thorn of scarlet…

License: Devil Beast ✦

Needs: ❂; DAGGER; SABER

When the Cultivator draws blood: install the ASWANG FANG to inflict a [FANG]—a thaumaturgical neurotoxin. ⟢ Any being with a [FANG] suffers +[FANGS] to KILL THE BUDDHA Checks against them. ⟢ Consume a [FANG] to shift into a mist or a swarm of bats or insects and fly adjacent to the consumed FANG’s target. This burns the Flame installed to that Fang. ⟢ Can be removed by an entity with [FANG] with a Physique + Adamance vs Cultivator's Heart + DEVIL BEAST. A succesful removal forces the Cultivator to release the Flame.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦, Technick, DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…until all the darknesses in the world deflowers her and she realizes…

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator splits herself in half. Her lower body stays where it is but her upper body moves around and can fly up to double her normal movement speed. She cannot go farther than 120m from her lower body. Any attack made against her lower body affects her upper body as well.

Seize and control with a curved weapon with inhuman speed.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ✹; DAGGER; SABER

Upon dealing damage to a Limb, activate DEMON CLAW to immediately Control that Limb. If the Limb is a Leg, can pull it instead to immediately knockdown.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦✦, Technick, DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…and she would bring about midnight in an arc across the wheel…

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Cultivator steps 2m and leaves behind a single Shadow of herself. It shares the Cultivator's Cultivations but does not take its own actions. A Demand [DEVIL BEAST] [Wits + Peripheral Oracle] Check must be passed by those near it or hostile to it to find out that it's just a shadow of the Cultivator. When the Shadow is damaged, it immediately dissipates and the Flame is released. All hostiles within 3m of the shadow have -2 to their next Check. When the Cultivator is damaged, she can swap places with the Shadow immediately and have the Shadow suffer it instead

The very phenomenon of consciousness arises from the self-awareness of death.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦

Needs: ✹; DAGGER; SABER

The Cultivator may activate Flickering Shade Technique to Counter any non Perfect Opening attempt to damage her. If she does, she teleports up to 5m afterwards.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦✦, Technick, DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
The very phenomenon of consciousness arises from the self-awareness of death. We only think because we will die. And so let us revel.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; DAGGER; SABER

While Internalized, +1 to all KILL THE BUDDHA Checks with Daggers. Upon drawing blood with a dagger, she may use the Technique to heal 1 HP to any one of her Parts.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦✦✦, Technick, DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…and the blood would sheathe her in shadow… Worry not, neophyte. You are already a murderer. The very act of living means you are killing yourself.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

When the Cultivator moves into a place where no hostile can see her, she can use this to turn invisible. When the Aswang makes an Ambush, she can uninstall the Flame to immediately generate 1 Perfect Opening.

…and then the beauty of her suffering is vindicated with seven horrible syllables as she realizes…

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Aswang shapes a part of her body, making limbs longer or a body part wider. Through this, she can give herself +1 Physique or +1 Motorics depending on the shaping, or she can increase her limbs' length up to 3m.

To be initiated into the Aswang, the Cultivator must ritually murder a being. The target must be a person of significance—a tyrant, an oppressor, a bourgeois, a capitalist, a traitor, an enemy of the People.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator sends a dance of black razors to erupt from her, shooting it in a vicious 7m long and 10m wide blast cone from her. The Razors are PIERCING.

The killing must be executed alone, in silence, and the Exdead must spend the night with the corpse, meditating on the nature of death and the exact moment of transition. At the end of the Vigil, the Aswang undergoes a Tribulation: their own self, coming to kill herself. She must fight off her own assassin, herself.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Cultivator can activate UMBRAL PHASING STYLE to turn any one of her Parts intangible: she cannot affect anyone with that Part (and whatever it's holding) but no one else can affect her either, as her physical signature is entangled into a different dimensional frequency.

After Initiation—the ingesting of the vaunted Devil's Centipede, the Cultivation Womb takes on the shape of a Charnel Mandala: a complex geometric pattern of interconnected deathmoments, each node a kill, each line a thread of fatal intent.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹; DAGGER; SABER

The Cultivator uses this to perform a KILL THE BUDDHA with DEVIL BEAST. Every Opening generated by this is a Perfect Opening, but she cannot Counter.
system.tags: Aswang, Devil Beast, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, DAGGER; SABER

system.description:
…all things in this world are but fabrications of the human mind.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Aswang can take on the shape of entities and beings that she has eaten or had sex with before. She largely preserves her traits and statistics while in this other form. Eating another entity’s Flesh recovers 1 burnt Flame or heals a random Part 1 HP. It can also fill the Protein requirement for a full meal. The Aswang can reach out and install ❂❂❂❂ to shape the flesh of another entity. If they’re willing, this goes smoothly. If not, this becomes an opposed Check: PHYSIQUE + DEVIL BEAST vs Heart + ADAMANCE. If the Cultivator wins, they deal 2 piercing damage to the Part being changed, and then The caster may forcibly shape their flesh.

The consummation of the Devil Beast. Become the utlimate monster.

License: Devil Beast ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ❂❂❂; MONSTER-SHIFTING

must be learned The Cultivator immediately transforms into a chimerical devil beast body that has multiple paradoxical and interpenetrating flesh parts. After installing, choose 3: ✦ Devil Beast Claws: Empty Hand deals +2 damage and cuts. ✦ Beastman Thews: +1 to any melee weapon. ✦ Monstrous Shintai: +1 to PHYS, MOT, or FAC. ✦ Divine Altar: +1 to MND, WIT, or HRT. ✦ Foxfire Beauty: The form gains a beautiful mien instead of a chimerical mien that cannot be pierced without powerful sorceries. ✦ Exoskeleton: The form gains +2 Soak to all Parts. ✦ Terrifying Argent Visage: The form becomes exceedingly horrible to look at: dealing damage also inflicts -1 Morale on the target.

The Dracontines' tutelary deity is Akshandata, the Heaven Wielder, who is a wrathful emanation of the peaceful buddha Amasantu. Their Sect founder is the legendary Underworld hero Kyi Kun-tze, who is said to hold the blood of the dragon himself.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ❂

While installed, the Cultivator has perfect balance and ignores penalties for balance and for moving. They can also move across liquid surfaces without breaking surface tension, stand on precarious and fragile surfaces, and even step on top of opponent's weapons. Additionally, when the Cultivator suffers KNOCKDOWN or JUGGLE they can uninstall the Flame to immediately bounce onto their feet or right side up.

The Dracontinesʼ ability to ascend into the heavens was said to be one of the first things taught to them by the Dragon Buddhas.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Dracontine shoots up 6m and then down to any point within 6m. If there's a target there, she must win a MOTORICS + SKY DRAGON vs the target's WITS + THEWS AND SINEWS. On a failure, she hits the ground and cracks it as the target moves out of the way. On a success, she deals weapon damage + 1 to a random Part.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
In many languages, such as in Kemrese, the word for Dragon—teruk—is also the word for thunder.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ❂; POLEARM OR DAGGER

While internalized, Daggers gain [REACH]. While installed, the Dracontine gains +1 to KILL THE BUDDHAs with the needed weapon against targets that are at least 2m away. And the needed weapons deal +1 damage as well.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
Dragons are sometimes known as naka, sometimes known as ruong, sometimes as loong. These are powerful, potent, reptilian beasts with a mastery over the elements of nature, can summon wind and rain, and arrive with the crashing of thunder.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Dracontine unleashes an impossible cavalcade of thrusts, so quick that it seems as if the Dracontine has a hundred spears striking at once. KILL THE BUDDHA against all in a 3m wide cone in front of the Cultivator. The storm of strikes makes it difficult to defend: the targets cannot Counter Solid or Perfect Openings.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
During the First World Revolution, the Invincible Blade Princess used their sky flying capabilities to hunt down enemy dragons. It was a massacre—one that the dragons are sure to never forget.

License: Sky Dragon ✦

Needs: ✹

Use this technick to immediately dash [3 + SKY DRAGON] in any direction, even while in midair. Can use this even within KILL THE BUDDHA or while JUGGLED to remove Juggled.

The Sky Pillar is an ancient, seemingly lost mountain realm in the Ceiling of the World, where the greatest of dragons lived for some time. The Sky Dragons ruled here, but were amicable with the Water and Earth Dragons, who were worshipped.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Cultivator strikes in a sudden rising arc, infused with Skyborne Sidhi. SOLID OPENING: the Cultivator deals damage to the Torso and suddenly knocks back the enemy 10m, even into the air. By burning +✹, she can immediately fly up with the same Sidhi to chase after the launched victim, keeping adjacent, allowing her to continue the KILL THE BUDDHA.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
The Dracontines used to be an ancient elite vanguard that fought for the Shennin Heavenly Emperor, fighting alongside the last Empress, the Invincible Blade Princess. After the Revolutions, they were subjected to rigorous criticism and rehabilitation. Even in the End of All Things, a large number of Dracontines are sympathetic to the Revolutionist Alignments.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

The Cultivator unleashes a sudden powerful spear attack by gripping their polearm with both hands, twisting quickly and suddenly thrusting their spear backwards and up. Like a horselancer wheeling around to strike at the foe behind them: as a Quick Opening, the Cultivator may immediately flashstep past the target and then strike backwards. This is an uncounterable option that [PIERCES] Soak. If this is used as the option for a Quick Opening generated from a Counter, this deals +2 damage and inflicts 5m KNOCKBACK.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
You could have left the earth by now. Unfettered by gravityʼs chains. You could have become free… but you chose to return to the earth. To gravity. A true dragon bodhisattva. You are the thunder.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹ + ❂❂❂❂

MANTRA: KADMA DRUK SKYOD | MUDRA: WISDOM CAST CHECK: PHYSIQUE + SKY DRAGON CASTING TIME: 12 SECONDS | POTENCY: 6 EFFECT: Launch into the skies—leap up to 20m and then stay airborne for as long as the Flame is Installed. The Dracontine’s Flying movement is equal to [SKY DRAGON]m/s.

Unleash! Revel! The Dragon Buddhas hath saith thus: to kill is to incur the karma of hell. But to kill in compassion of the other—for the betterment of all—is a killing that requires the two core essences of Enlightenment: Wisdom and Compassion. To perform this Enlightened Killing still accrues Karma, but this is a Karma a Buddha will gladly suffer for the sake of All Beings. And in this practice the reverend Buddha soberly understands the truth: that even Karma is Not True!

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

Perfect Opening: the Dracontine spins her spear and summons draconic Sidhi as she does. At the height of the spin, she releases it in a straight line. Draconic Sidhi creates a lance of tyrant rage and fervor inflicting [PIERCING] Torso damage to all entities in a 6m straight line, 1m wide.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
The Dragon Buddhaʼs own martial art is said to be lost to time. Savage Carving Fang was once known as the Eighty-Eight Million Galaxy Dragon Fury, but only 5 of its attacks were preserved. Perhaps an Immortal Cultivator of greater skill will be able to find the scattered and lost strikes of the Fury. It is said that only a True Dragon Buddha can perform the sacrosanct technick once again.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

Solid Opening: the Dracontine performs a rapid and wild combination of strikes, each one in the rapacious ravaging fury of a dragon. She deals +2 damage to the Torso, and then may fly 1m afterwards as she is carried by the wings of their fury. If she uses this as a Perfect Opening, it becomes [PIERCING], but can only still target the Torso.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
One of the Dragon Buddhas is known as Huangloong—a name reserved for the Dragon Kings. It was the fabled Huangloong of the Nail of Heaven, who taught this murderous technique said to bring down the highest of the deities of the ancient Celestial Feudalist Aristocracy, now converted into the Heavenly Bourgeoisie. Strike true, and bring heaven down to earth.

License: Sky Dragon ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹; POLEARM OR DAGGER

Perfect Opening: she may deal damage to the target's Torso and then suddenly infuse the weapon with the Heaven- Scourging Sidhi to send herself, the weapon, and the target hurtling down to earth. For every 2m descended by the target, deal another damage. Upon striking the earth, the target suffers KNOCKDOWN and 2 [PIERCING] Damage to all Parts.
system.tags: Dracontine, Sky Dragon, ✦✦✦✦✦, Technick, POLEARM OR DAGGER

system.description:
Like a pistol, throw a hand out and summon a shard of annihilation.

License: Black Sorcery ✦

Needs: —

MANTRA: VARAM | MUDRA: Spear -> Dragon CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 3 seconds | POTENCY 4 EFFECT: Range of up to [10 x BLACK SORCERY] meters. Deal [BLACK SORCERY] damage. Can be resisted with a Mind + Adamance Check to halve the damage, min. 1.

The Eschatonian Sect was constructed by the Scarlet Cadre. Those who followed the Metteya Scriptures, the Future Enlightened One, who will turn the Wheel, and face the world back to the Law.

License: Black Sorcery ✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: LAGYAB VARAM | MUDRA: Earth → Heat → Spear CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 3 seconds | POTENCY 3 EFFECT: Summon a blast of roiling fire to erupt within 20m, spreading to a 2m radius. Deals [BLACK SORCERY] piercing damage and sets them on fire.

Strike with an invisible blade.

License: Black Sorcery ✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: KALIS | MUDRA: Dragon -> Spear CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 1 second | POTENCY 3 EFFECT: KILL THE BUDDHA with an invisible blade with the Spear mudra. Deal [BLACK SORCERY] uncounterable damage. The range of Slash is equal to [BLACK SORCERY] meters.

The emulation of the poltergeist. A very popular and very feared black sorcery magick.

License: Black Sorcery ✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: TA BI | MUDRA: Dragon -> Wisdom CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 1 second | POTENCY 3 EFFECT: Forcefully knockback an entity within 10m that can be seen up to [2 + BLACK SORCERY].

The Commission of Battle Magick received the consent of oppressed masters everywhere to craft a revolutionary battle magick, from the depths of sea caves to the peaks of mountain retreats.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹

Mantra: KISLAP VARAM | Mudra: Noose → Stillness CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 6 seconds | POTENCY 4 EFFECT: A point within 20m is ionized and bursts in electric arcs to a 2m radius from the point. All within suffer [BLACK SORCERY] piercing damage and if they're wearing anything conductive they're Stunned for 3 seconds.

A magick where you take away the heat in a particular locality to accelerate entropy.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: TEGUS VARAM | MUDRA: Heaven → Stillness → Intent CHECK: MIND + ESKATON SORCERY CAST TIME: 6 seconds | POTENCY: 6 EFFECT: Flash-freeze a point within 20m, summoning a 3m tall and wide pillar of ice. Any entity that fails to avoid it (against Demand [BLACK SORCERY - 1, min. 1]) is encased in the pillar of ice, frozen. The Pillar has 30DR and melts at the usual rate.

Even the vaunted Batara Kala, an ancient Deity who has ascended to one of the Deepest Heavens returned to teach his Carving Magick.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

MANTRA: RIPOR VARAM | MUDRA: Heaven → Man → Earth → Noose CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 12 seconds | POTENCY 8 EFFECT: Overload neurons on all hostiles within a 10m radius. All must succeed on a Demand [BLACK SORCERY + 1] Mind + Stillness Check or lose 3 Morale immediately.

They dance on the knife’s edge: most traitor Eschatonians become jobbers for the high military. for HAECO or for Amatsu. The communist party needs their explosive power the most.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

The Cultivator can now burn or install HP in a Part in place of Flame when she uses her Esoteric Techniques. She can use this to even disable her own Parts (or Cleave them if they have all Mortal Wounds) as long as they have an Health levels left. Any attacks made with Techniques from burnt health gain +2 dice.

A more fine tuned version of the poltergeist emulation. This one is pure telekinetic prowess, wielding nothing but the mind. The annihilation of stasis.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂; BLARE

MANTRA: TA BI SA BI MUDRA: Dragon -> Wisdom -> Thunderbolt CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 1 second | POTENCY 5 EFFECT: As long as installed, move 1 object or entity that can be seen within 20m up to [2 + BLACK SORCERY] meters per second.

Emanate a slash of pure annihilative vajra energy, burgeoning from one's cacotopic soul. Crafted by the 8-Armed Asura, an Annihilation Cult who followed the Sword Law. They believed that focusing eskatonic sidhi into an information-cutting blade is the first step to Enlightenment.They believed that in the destruction can one find love.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

Mantra: IHIVA Mudra: Heaven → Sword CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 1 second | POTENCY 3 EFFECT: Unleash a sudden and immediate cut at someone within [10 x BLACK SORCERY] Meters: deal [BLACK SORCERY] piercing damage to them immediately. // [Burn +✹✹] Mark out a 10m long line from the caster. Anything within the line suffers the damage.

A manifestation of the Buddha Metteya, and her return heralds the final End of a current World Order and the establishment of a new World Order that is beneficial for the Wretched of the Earth, so that Hingsajagra might finally ascend to the next stage of civilization. To the teachings of the Eschaton, the end is nothing but the Trichiliocosm’s movement to its next incarnation.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Caster can bring the Omniverse’s Heat Death to the present and obliterate all illusion of time: when she Casts Magick, she can use MAHAKALI to immediately cast it, without needing to make Checks.

Summon a lance of pure annihilative vajra energy that explodes in a burst of thermobaric ruination.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹

Mantra: SAGUNA | Mudra: Heaven → Thunderbolt CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 6 seconds | POTENCY 12 EFFECT: The caster can choose a point she can see. She sends a vajra arrow to that area, exploding as it touches any nongas point. When it explodes, it expands into a 50m radius, and deals piercing [BLACK SORCERY + 2] damage to all Parts of all entities within. Afterwards, a Part must be Cleaved from the caster, unless she is touching another person. She can transfer the Cleaving to the other person.

The Eschatonian cuts herself out of reality for a moment, apparating again in a different location through advanced entanglement principles.

License: Black Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

Mantra: PARATITYA WARAM Mudra: Heaven → Wheel → Ego- Cutting → Intent → Violence CHECK: MIND + BLACK SORCERY CAST TIME 2 seconds | POTENCY 6 EFFECT: The caster teleports up to x2 her 2 x [MIND + BLACK SORCERY] in meters. Beyond that, there’s a 1-in-6 chance of her not appearing for 2d6 days instead. // [+✹] Force this teleportation upon another instead as an opposed Mind + BLACK SORCERY vs Heart + Stillness Check. Should the caster win, she immediately teleports them the distance. Should she lose, only half, and the target chooses where to reappear.
system.mudra: Heaven → Wheel → Ego- Cutting → Intent → Violence

system.description:
We are the oldest continuous cultivation tradition in the Utter Islands, predating even the Enlightened One. Our roots lie in the ancient pyre-sages of Razru, who first discovered that the human body contained a microcosmic furnace—the Lower Cauldron—that could refine ambient Sidhi into pills.

License: Internal Elixir ✦

Needs: ✹

Demand 2 | Duration 1 day Goal 8 | Limit 4 Must be done in an alchemy laboratory or refinery. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. She can make one of the following Pills: N/A DELUXE ITEM 0.01 KG HEALING PILL When ingested, heal 2 Health from a damaged Part. N/A DELUXE ITEM 0.01 KG ANTIDOTE PILL When ingested, immediately removes an ongoing poison from one's system. N/A DELUXE ITEM 0.01 KG FULFILNESS PILL When ingested, immediately removes the need for food for [INTERNAL ELIXIR] days. N/A DELUXE ITEM 0.01 KG FULFILNESS PILL Can be set on fire. It turns into a floating fireball that orbits the user for up to [INTERNAL ELIXIR] minutes.

The second heresy: the body is not a thing to be protected, but a condition to be internalized

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦

Needs: —

As long as this Technick is Internalized, the Cultivator has +[Physique] HP to all Parts.

Imbue a pill with Sidhi and toss it.

License: Internal Elixir ✦

Needs: ✹

Can KILL THE BUDDHA with a Pill in the Inventory, having the same statistics as a LAUNCHER. It will deal 2 damage unless it's a Healing Pill, in which case it will heal its stated amount. Depending on the type of pill a secondary effect might happen: poison, smoke, flash or explosive (2m radius blast).

To be one with the Pure Movement of the World is to know all of its esoteric angles.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

As long as the Flame is installed, the Cultivator can see up to 100m of her, though she only sees anything behind obstructing objects as heat signatures. This prevents her from being Ambushed.

To be one with the Pure Movement of the World is to be its wind.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦

Needs: ❂

When the Cultivator runs across vertical surfaces, or across water or any tricky terrain she can install LIGHTNESS TECHNIQUE to stick to that surface and run across it in any direction as normal. This includes such things like pillars flying toward them, allowing them to "avoid" those. While installed, her Movement Rate is doubled and she can leap up to her movement rate in any direction as well.

Outer Alchemy is chemistry. The practice of concocting, boiling, forging, and crafting pills, elixirs, and other alchemical reagents and items to strengthen one’s body in an attempt to attain immortality.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂

Demand 3 | Duration 1 hour | Goal 10 | Limit 5 This is a project to be done within an alchemy laboratory or refinery. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. On success, she can transmute various nonmagical materials into other non-magical materials of similar mass and complexity, though the object cannot be larger than her. Up to 50kg.This cannot create gold, silver, any highly complex element or mineral or any esoteric substance.

Yaji not only means the ideological representation of “Man” but also means “Way” of things. When a thing is yaji, that thing is symmetric and in line with the Supreme Principle, the ultimate suchness of all things. Some consider it as Heaven, or Tian. Others call it Buddha Nature. Others call it “God.”

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦

Needs: —

The Fangshi meditates to turn her whole body into a furnace. She can now refine Fangshi Pills and Elixirs without a laboratory, just her own hands, though she still needs the appropriate materials. More importantly, she can transmute her very own hands and skin, allowing her to summon fire and winds to strike with her Empty Hand, giving her Empty Hand REACH and letting it deal PIERCING.

It is from Internal Alchemy that one realizes a profound truth: that the soul is not separate from the Body. In fact, it arises from the Body. With this body, you will break down the gates of heaven and steal Enlightenment from the mouths of Immortals.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

Summon a 3m long shield within 2m of the Cultivator. The Shield has [10 x INTERNAL ELIXIR] dr and cannot be moved through by enemies but can by allies. It is also translucent, made purely of Barrier Sidhi. Anyone behind the Shield is completely safe behind it—all attacks hit the semispherical shield. Only those partially behind it get to use it as just Cover.

By attaining immortality one achieves physical harmony with The Yaji, as opposed to the mental harmony of the other practices.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

Demand 3 | Duration 3 hours | Goal 12 | Limit 6 This is a project to be done within an alchemy laboratory or refinery, with the appropriate equipment and with at least 1,000mag and spirit herbs. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. To create the one of the following Elixirs: PRESTIGE ITEM N/A 0.50 KG CHAKRA ELIXIR Ingesting this immediately restores 2 burnt Flame. PRESTIGE ITEM N/A 0.50 KG DISGUISE ELIXIR Ingesting this immediately changes one part about the ingester's face or voice. Someone who knows her before or is exceptionally observant can still see through it. N/A PRESTIGE ITEM 0.50 KG THUNDERBOLT ELIXIR Ingesting this grants the user +1 WIT and +1 MOT for 24 hours. This effect does not stack. The ingester then suffers 3 piercing damage to the torso. N/A PRESTIGE ITEM 0.50 KG INFERNO ELIXIR After ingesting, for 3 hours, the drinker becomes immune to fire and can control and produce flame from her hands. This allows her to set people aflame as well as deal 2 piercing damage if she attacks with these flames that can be fired up to 10m from her.

Deep within a Sentient Being’s subtlest body is the Heart of Beast, chained not by Reason but by Ignorance. The deepest infernal Vajra Beast within is nothing but Omniscience as well. Omnipotence? Omniscience? Both are Empty. Both are Luminiscent Enlightened Nature.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; Empty Hand

Perfect Opening: Deal piercing damage to the Torso and force the target's Subtle Body out of their physical body. This astral body is pushed back 10m. Anything that happens to the astral body happens to the physical body. The physical body needs to physically return to the astral body to refuse. While the Soul is out, the target suffers -2 MND.
system.tags: Fangshi, Internal Elixir, ✦✦✦✦, Technick, Empty Hand

system.description:
The apex fire, burning soul and karma.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

While in Samadhi, summon a fire that burns either a single thing or creature within 30m or all within a 10m long, 5m wide cone. Those that fail to get out of the way or avoid it immediately suffer an Inferno that cannot be removed and deals [INTERNAL ELIXIR] damage per second for 1 minute.

The Ultramystics call us reactionaries because we do not march with the masses. The Techgnostics call us primitives because we do not replace our flesh with brass. But we are the ones who have actually become immortal—not through the exploitation of spirits, not through the consumption of others' cultivation, but through the perfect refinement of the self.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

The Cultivator touches the earth and knows the current state of the earth up to a 50m radius of her. She knows if there's anyone touching the earth and what happened up to 3 nights ago. For the next hour, anything she does within this 50m radius area has +2 dice. She can extend this knowledge and benefit to any number of entities within 15m of her.

To strengthen the soul is to attain divinity. To touch the infernal Beast within is to be closer to enlightenment than any Ialdabaoth or Mara. This once cracked Sokana, the closest orbital heaven, during the Second World Revolution, and caused all orbital heavens thereafter to be built further into the Akasha.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹

Demand 5 | Duration 5 hours | Goal 12 | Limit 6 Needs a Dragon Tooth, Dragon Eye, and Dragon Tongue along with 10,000mag. Upon accomplishing the Project, the wielder must burn the needed Flame. To create the Five Dragons Pill: PRESTIGE ITEM N/A 0.50 KG FIVE DRAGONS PILL The ingester takes 3 piercing damage to her Head. Then she can manipulate, control, and shape earth, fire, lightning or water within 20m that she can see. This cannot be larger than a waterfall nor a large 5 meter wide and 20 meter tall pillar. If used to attack, it deals [crafter's INTERNAL ELIXIR] piercing damage along with any other additional environmental effect.

There are no words to describe the Yaji. And so I will describe everything else, so that the emptiness may be its shape.

License: Internal Elixir ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹

At any time, activate ACTION-NON-ACTION to make the Cultivator or any entity she can see perform any maneuver, even within a KILL THE BUDDHA. This can be any Opening.

I Sublime archers even in the age of guns, they have become impenetrable with their ability to infuse attacks with penetrating Sidhi.

License: Solar Bow ✦

Needs: ✹

Upon firing an arrow, the Cultivator can activate this to propel it with a blast of Bowman Sidhi. It goes in a straight line up to 30m long and goes straight through most things that it hits.

Developed by the first master of Dragonfly Cutting, Ingkan. Ingkan teaches to be endlessly and effervescently resourceful.

License: Solar Bow ✦

Needs: —

As long as this is Internalized, the Cultivator now does not need AMMO to fire Bow, Crossbow, or Launcher Attacks, as she uses anything lighter than 0.25kg (a mote of dust, a falling flower petal, a piece of her sidhi, a ray of light) as a damaging projectile.

Developed by the first master of Dragonfly Cutting, Ingkan. Ingkan teaches to be endlessly and effervescently resourceful.

License: Solar Bow ✦

Needs: ✹ [X]

Needs ✹ or ✹✹. Upon firing an arrow, burn the Flame to split it in half—the second arrow hits a random Part. Burn an extra Flame to split it into three arrows and have them converge into a single Part.

The Hamayumi deals in expunging evil, as it means “Evil Purging Bow.”

License: Solar Bow ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

Upon firing an arrow, activate this to strengthen it with Evil Purging Sidhi. All malevolent INTRA-INT entities (ghosts, demons, Black Nectar infected, Marionette Puppets, black sorcery creations, and so on) suffer double damage from this arrow.

The first technique taught to all Dragonfly Cutters. Gain control over the battlefield through controlled breathing and sharp eyesight.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦

Needs: ❂❂

The Cultivator sinks into SINGLE POINT meditation after dealing damage to a single point on an object or a part on an enemy to lock in on that point. While meditating, all her arrow shots magnetize automatically to the locked in point.

All Houyi fashion themselves after legendary archers and bowmen. Even though not all Houyi wield bows—some prefer the long rifle, or the crossbow, or the launcher—they do it all the same.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦

Needs: ❂

The Houyi can install a Circle of Precision around her to a radius of 2m. While within the Circle, her and any allies within it have +100m to the maximum range of their ranged weapons and gain +2d to any KILL THE BUDDHA attempts.

Sashi the First Hunter invented this technique at the request of her student. The student was bloodthirsty but righteous, killing a peaceful demon village.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦

Needs: ❂; bow, crossbow, longgun

Choose a target within weapon range. Mark their very information into the mind's eye. The target becomes a valid target for any weapon even without line of sight, behind cover, and so on. All damage against this target gains +1.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Shoot a superprecise shot, informed by attunement to the Flow, and pin down an enemy.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Quick Opening: pin a target's clothing or limb (deal damage) to a wall or floor, counting as Control over that Limb. The Cultivator may install +❂ to make that projectile impossible to pull out without a successful Demand [SOLAR BOW] Physique + Thews and Sinews Check.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
It is difficult to explain the concept of Yaji within the Cosmic Signifier. It can be translated as “Virtue” or as “Way” or as “Path” or as “Rightness.” Yaji is supposed to be unknowable: the act of doing something in accordance with the Yaji will express itself with the feeling of utmost rightness, of feeling like you are doing something right. This feeling is immanent within all beings, no matter the reincarnation.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Activate this at any point to deal damage to a chosen target (random Part if a lifeform) within wielded weapon's range.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
The ancient archery art of SOLAR BOW partially grew out of the primeval Cutting Dragonfly Wings bow art: once the prime archery art of the Revolutionary Army across the world, it has since become a zealously guarded secret to keep the knowledges safe from the reactionary forces of the United Union.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Fire a single arrow into the air and it splits into a hundred arrows through Arrow Sidhi. It falls upon a point within 20m that expands to a 3m wide radius blast. Those that fail to dodge it or get out of the blast suffer weapon damage to all Parts.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Attune with the All of Nature. A single flow.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂; bow, crossbow, longgun

Spend time unmoving and then install this Flame. While installed, the Cultivator cannot move, but they become completely invisible and untrackable by mundane means until they make considerable action that produces large amounts of sound.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
What is the Yaji? To define it is to become unable to grasp the very concept of the Yaji. It is undefinable through logic. It must be experienced and it must be lived. In the same way as how a beginner blacksmith struggles to create a sword but an advanced blacksmith moves without thinking, without motion. To experience Yaji is the Yaji.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Upon dealing damage with the needed weapons, activate SUN BREAKING JAVELIN to gain [CRUSHING] to the attack.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Sects that are friendly with the Heaven Pillar are given leniency and allowed to learn the secret arts. The Revolutionary Army destroyed them when they tried to break off, attempting to create their own ethnostate. The Houyi have saved their arts and integrated them into their own.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹; bow, crossbow, longgun

Upon aiming as a Quick Opening, immediately generate a Perfect Opening instead of a Solid for the purposes of shooting.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
Sects that are friendly with the Heaven Pillar are given leniency and allowed to learn the secret arts. The Revolutionary Army destroyed them when they tried to break off, attempting to create their own ethnostate. The Houyi have saved their arts and integrated them into their own.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦

Needs: ❂; bow, crossbow, longgun

While installed, the BOWS, CROSSBOWS, and LONGGUNS gain +2 Rate.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, longgun

system.description:
The vaunted Houyi arrived a bit earlier than most in the war against Heaven. They were the first backline in the first few battalions, established in the chaos of the Decades of Carnage. Most Houyi are feared amongst the heavens—a coterie of 300 Houyi struck down and killed the Seven Suns Immortal, who was one of the most powerful Immortals at that time.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

The Cultivator can empower attempt of committing violence with SUPREME WISDOM FOCUS, where she adds her +[STILLNESS] to the dice pool.

Kaburas of the Gleaming Dark invented this technique to better serve his job as a Magister for Soreh. For his penance after the Second World Revolution, he teaches it to all that wish, provided they will kill an Imperial or Capitalist. The Contemplatives of Dagger Forest Mountain learned to be possessed by the rapidity of Non-Thought, moving faster to defeat the Dragonfly God of Quickness.

License: Solar Bow ✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹; bow, crossbow, launcher, longgun

The Cultivator's weapon explodes with coruscating Sun-Shattering Sidhi, and she commits violence. The range of this attack is infinite, as long as she can see or knows where the target is. Upon dealing damage to any Part, she may convert all her dice that came up as 4+ into +1 damage on that instance of Damage.
system.tags: Houyi, Solar Bow, ✦✦✦✦, Technick, bow, crossbow, launcher, longgun

system.description:
Immanents are always in a half-trance state that lets them channel Pure White Sidhi to be able to better sublate wounds into healed fragments.

License: White Sorcery ✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: ALMA MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 6 seconds POTENCY 3 EFFECT: Heal a single Part within 10m by 2 HP. Staunch Bleeding originating from that Part and sterilize its open wounds. Embedded objects remain and may need removal before the wound can safely close.

To heal more than one requires a heart that is not pure. Compassion does not denote purity. It denotes courage and wisdom. It denotes a soul that has been blackened but still insists on doing good. This is the truth of sublation.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹

MANTRA: AL MA KSHE TRA MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom → Dragon CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 12 seconds POTENCY 6 EFFECT: Heal all Parts of a single person by 2 HP within 10m.

Immanents are often the closest thing to "religious figures" in their particular locales. They are sometimes Vicars of the Kingdom of Heaven, or Bishops of the Merkabahn Church, or Dialecticians of the 10,000 Dragons.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: ARU MA NA MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom → Sword → Heaven CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 18 seconds POTENCY 6 EFFECT: Choose a point within 20m. All damaged entities within a 3m radius from it heal all their Parts by 2 HP.

The Immanents became protectors. They spread their knowledges with other places—particularly, Selorong synthesized their Arts with their own Soul Herald practices, creating the new Celestial Restoration Art that can be taught by all, without the need for an innate healing spirit to choose you.

License: White Sorcery ✦

Needs: ❂

MANTRA: BE DZRA MUDRA: Heaven → Earth → Violence CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 3 seconds POTENCY 3 EFFECT: Choose someone or something within 12m. They gain [WHITE SORCERY] Magick Soak to up to 2 Parts. This Magick Soak is reduced before normal Soak. Lasts until the Soak is depleted or until the Flame is uninstalled.

Esrafyl is the celestine of healing, protection, and medicine. Sometimes considered a deity. Othertimes considered just a registry angel. He is a powerful entity all the same that sides clandestinely with the Working Class.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: ES RA FYL I AN MUDRA: Wisdom → Sword CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 3 seconds POTENCY 3 EFFECT: The Cultivator directs their compassion upon someone she can see. She can alleviate any Burning, Stun, or Winded from them.

Immanents entangle with various angelic entities in a bid to wield the inherent dialectic of the world. So as the Man negates God, so does the Angel negate man. The Immanents are not strangers to freaky occultic ritual, and much less so are they strangers to invoking the various angels that drift across the Heavens. The Astral Seraphic Sidhi of Oryeline burns to purge his allies of venom.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: OR YE LINE MUDRA: Heaven → Thunderbolt CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 1 hour POTENCY 8 EFFECT: The Cultivator magickally negates the black thread of venom: one entity she can touch is cured of any single disease or poison.

Immanents tap even upon the imagery of healing buddhas, of humans that have attained enlightenment, to sublate all things.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦

Needs: ✹

MANTRA: RE PANG MUDRA: Wisdom CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 3 seconds POTENCY 4 EFFECT: The target can immediately dispel a magick she has identified as with countermagick.

"Holiness and sacrality are not qualities of reality but the imposition of reason. Anything can become Divine, for everything is Divine and Not- Divine." — Georg of the Thothian Ajna

License: White Sorcery ✦

Needs: ❂❂

MANTRA: JI MUDRA: Heaven → Wisdom → Violence CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 6 minutes POTENCY 6 EFFECT: A stationary 5m radius centered where cast for as long as the Flame is installed: four columns emerge from the world’s reflection. Between them, a roof assembles itself from white cloud and vermilion beams. This place is a consecrated temple. Dust refuses to cross the threshold. Ordinary rain parts around the eaves. Surfaces become sterile beneath light cast by lamps that contain no flame. Succor and Triage Checks gain +2 dice within. With bedding and adequate food, the formation counts as a proper place of rest for healing. It creates no supplies and offers no barrier to weapons.

The Immanents eventually became known as the Divine Hand of the Mountains when they were forced to flee into the mountains after the victory of the Heavenly Bourgeoisie. They compiled all their learnings, magicks, technicks, and inscribed them upon imperishable stone. Then, they kept it within hidden soul caves, sealed by powerful magicks.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦

Needs: ✹

The Cultivator reduces a long operation or medical treatment to seconds, at a rate of 1 hour into 1 minute.

The Celestial Healers became much wanted healers in the Revolutions. There was never a cadre without them. They did this because they knew—the day of the Red Sun was soon.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹

MANTRA: MULAK LANTA MUDRA: Heaven → Earth → Heat CHECK: HEART + WHITE SORCERY CAST TIME 12 seconds POTENCY 12 EFFECT: The Cultivator must touch someone and heal all HP to that part. If a Cleaved limb can be attached to that Part, this Magick can heal and resuture that limb back to full HP.

Magick Healing targets Health—that is to say, the Inner Sidhi. The Life Force of a person. It does not regrow lost limbs or impaired functions, only the vivacity of a person. And so, surgeons, prostheticians, and other medical professionals are still required for more specific healing jobs.

License: White Sorcery ✦✦✦✦✦

Needs: ✹✹✹✹✹✹

Perform a ritual for 8 hours to cast the Magick: DHARANI OF ING KUNG. The Immanent loses half of her max Health— if her max Health is already 5 or lower, she must die instead as an exchange. The Immanent chooses someone she loves and brings him back from the brink of death, as long as it hasn’t been 24 hours and she can touch him skin to skin or bone to bone. They are healed to full Health, though they do not reconstitute any lost limbs. While in Samadhi, the Ing Kung Immanent can now focus her Compassion Sidhi into a burning halo. She must burn 4 Flame and channel at least 6 hours (lasts even when Samadhi ends), without moving, to expunge a single area within 10m of rot and entropy and fill it once again with flourishing life, at the prime of its life. Any sentient beings and objects within this area are cleansed of any viruses and diseases and are healed of all Wounds. Any demonic taint or corruptive Sidhi is vaporized, unless the corruptive Sidhi is too strong, in which case it is revealed instead.

The Distant Stars are all Archons—servants of the Cosmic Chakravartins. All the stars are other heavens. They are watching us.

License: Astral ✦

Needs: ✹

Every night, when the sky is clear and she can see at least some stars, she can cast a d6 to glean the estrellian entanglements. Her and the rest of her Party gain the following status until dusk of the next day. 1 The Lotus. +1 Beast Shrine. 2 The Spear. +1 Concrete Analysis. 3 The Mountain. +1 Adamance. 4 The Spire. +1 Thews and Sinews. 5 The Ewer. +1 Stillness. 6 The Ox. +1 Manual Labor.

Most common battle magick used by the military employed by most Spheres. Drawing power from one's self is diffuclt, drawing power from the Stars through Sidhic Entanglement Ritual Algorithm is easier.

License: Astral ✦

Every death she suffers this way grants her +1 Perversion and +50 XP, and adds +4 to all her Checks for 10 minutes. If the Ultramystic has a Right Hand, the Ultramystic can choose to die. If she does, the Right Hand gains all her current Licenses and Traits. That Right Hand cannot use this ability.

The Wukongs have perfected the art of patience, becoming like mountains, and challenging all to strike them. Like their name’s sake, their Sidhi are born from spheres of rock.

Any Aggravated entity that leaves the melee weapon range of the Cultivator suffers 1 piercing damage to a random Part.

This is the Ego Beyond Ego. Otherwise known as the God Beyond God. At the core of the Vajra Sutra is nothing but Emptiness. So remember to spit It out.

Not just a metaphor. With just an incantation, the Wukongs are able to emulate the actions of the hallowed Bhante, turning into stone and becoming impervious to all things.

By meditating upon interdependence, Wukongs can impossibly swap places with someone they pledge to protect, moving intramaterially.

"Nothing in the world is difficult... only the mind makes it so." — Wukong Shi Hou.

Upon dealing damage with the imbued weapon, she can leave the weapon behind to effectively pin the target in place.

Exorcists are integral to the Revolutionary Army: the Forces of Reaction and Liberalism wield the Spirits the geists to strengthen their forces and fight back against revolutionary mysticks and wizards. A way to bind these entities is imperative. Thus why in the rebuilding of the Communist Party it became imperative to establish the Zhongkui Sect.

Spirits cannot cross these Partitions. For sentient beings these become low-hazy light walls that can be used as cover and is difficult to move through. If placed upon an object, the Zhongkui turns that object into an anathema to Spirits. Spirits fall away from the item, and using it as a weapon imbues that weapon with the [HOLY] property.

The oldest exorcist magick, taught by the spiritworkers and shamans of the old world. The world is the world of spirits, not of man. May we all attain concordance with Void.

These are emergent informational patterns that arise from the dialectical movement of an ecosystem powered by Sidhi that sometimes inhabit an animal, or cobble together a coherent, mythic form. Appeasing these requires tapping into informational resonances, a form of mystic science that the ancestors had a sensitivity to through application of symbol. It's much less complicated to just eat them all.
